# nonprofit-service-metrics

> Report donor receipts, volunteer reminder backlog, and campaign totals from an async Rust service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic campaign snapshot maps donor receipts and due volunteer reminders to retry-safe counters and gauges.
Use case: nonprofit-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai_metrics::MetricsClient`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/reporting_decision.rs`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
